title: The Detector Teaches Itself: Lightweight Self-Supervised Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

Open-Vocabulary Object Detection (OVD) bridges this gap by leveraging language supervision to localize and recognize arbitrary objects [2].

However, these methods suffer from a domain gap between holistic images used for VLM pre-training and cropped object regions used during detection.
However, a key question remains: how can we enhance regional feature adaptivity of VLMs while preserving the model's zero-shot ability in a simple and self-contained way.
